newsitem.title: UK: Eurotunnel turnout low at cancelled EGM.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel turnout low at cancelled EGM.

text.p: Anglo-French Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel said on Tuesday shareholders representing only 6.76 percent of its stock were on hand for the meeting scheduled to approve its debt restructuring plan.
The company cancelled Tuesday's meeting due to the lack of a quorum and rescheduled the extraordinary general meeting for July 10.
Eurotunnel said shareholders holding some 33 percent of its shares had to be present or represented in order for Tuesday's meeting to take place. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
